title: Player removed without death at end of session
explanation: At frame 634 a "player_removed" event occurs (event text "player_removed") while the last state snapshot (frame 1379) shows the player alive with 0 deaths and a score of 100. No prior death or kill event is logged, indicating the player disappeared unexpectedly. This removal coincides with a second "session_end" event after the first one at frame 633, suggesting an abrupt termination of the player lifecycle without proper death handling or score update.
